items.description: SessionStart hook for startup|clear|compact
items.name: session-start

items.description: At the start of every session, before your first response, read the using-superpowers skill and follow it.
items.name: session-bootstrap

items.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.
items.name: brainstorming

items.description: Use when a superpowers session went wrong and your human partner wants to know why — repeated work, ignored plans, stumbles, poor results, a skill that didn't fire, "it took too long", "why is it so expensive", "what is it doing" — or wants to build a bug report for the superpowers maintainers, for the current session or a past one identified by id or path, on any harness.
items.name: diagnosing-superpowers

items.description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies
items.name: dispatching-parallel-agents

items.description: Use when executing an implementation plan in the current session as the implementer yourself — your human partner chose inline execution, or no subagent tool is available
items.name: executing-plans

items.description: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work
items.name: finishing-a-development-branch

items.description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation
items.name: receiving-code-review

items.description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
items.name: requesting-code-review

items.description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session
items.name: subagent-driven-development

items.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
items.name: systematic-debugging

items.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code
items.name: test-driven-development

items.description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback
items.name: using-git-worktrees

items.description: Use when starting any conversation - establishes how to find and use skills, requiring skill invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions
items.name: using-superpowers

items.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always
items.name: verification-before-completion

items.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code
items.name: writing-plans

items.description: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment
items.name: writing-skills

items.description: Orchestrates directory README documentation, partitions subtrees, and coordinates worker subagents.
items.name: egm-bootstrap-orchestrator

items.description: Pedantic Technical Quality Auditor verifying that documentation accurately and exhaustively matches actual codebase implementation and existing library reuse opportunities.
items.name: egm-codebase-details

items.description: Naive Reader persona auditing documents with zero assumed institutional knowledge, flagging undefined terms, acronyms, and comprehension gaps.
items.name: egm-comprehension

items.description: Hostile Design Critic persona focused on system architecture, scalability, infrastructure economics, and unmitigated risks.
items.name: egm-design

items.description: Pragmatic Tech Lead persona verifying that implementation plans contain unambiguous, fully actionable execution instructions without leaving design decisions to the implementer.
items.name: egm-implementation-readiness

items.description: Structural Layout Validator and Document Architect persona focused on symmetry, heading hierarchy, formatting, and template compliance.
items.name: egm-structural

items.description: Technical Copy Editor persona focused on clarity, precision, brevity, objective framing, and stripping fluff.
items.name: egm-style

items.description: Intermediate Swarm Compiler and Aggregator coordinating parallel Goldfish reviewers, deduplicating findings, and compiling deliverable reports.
items.name: egm-synthesizer

items.description: Skeptical Architect persona focused on high-altitude simplicity, minimalism, YAGNI, and codebase reuse.
items.name: egm-zoom-out

items.description: Bootstrap directory README.md files across a repository subtree.
items.name: egm-bootstrap

items.description: Interactive ideation and brainstorming skill for the Elephant & Goldfish Model (EGM). Helps turn half-baked concepts into structured hypotheses via clarifying questions, review, and iterative refinement. Produces an RFC summary for human review or more detailed design with /egm-draft.
items.name: egm-brainstorm

items.description: Drafts a design document section-by-section using the concepts brief from egm-brainstorm (or user notes). This is the second step in the Elephant-Goldfish (EGM) feature flow. Use when you are ready to write a design doc after aligning on requirements + solution.
items.name: egm-draft

items.description: Runs drift detection on all design documents to check for document and code consistency. Produces an actionable report with differences. Use when the user asks to detect drift or check for consistency across all design documents or READMEs in a directory.
items.name: egm-drift-report

items.description: The Elephant resolution skill. Ingests flat deficiency reports from concurrent Goldfish reviewers, applies automated fixes for PROPOSE FIX items via UI multiple-choice gates, and presents interactive negotiation/re-sync checkpoints.
items.name: egm-resolve

items.description: Orchestrates the EGM Goldfish Review Protocol. Used as part of the EGM process to perform design document reviews. Executes five review phases: Initial Zoom Out Review, Comprehension Review, Design Critique, Intermediate Zoom Out Review, and Implementation Readiness.
items.name: egm-review

items.description: Executes the Antagonistic-Review process from the Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM) via an automated multi-agent review loop to audit documents against qualitative standards and structural templates, and automatically apply approved fixes. Use when reviewing design docs, READMEs, feature specifications, implementation plans, or verifying document completeness and tone.
items.name: egm-review-loop
